subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

It's not our book; it must be__ theres__.
solution:
The correct answer is **Theirs.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **possessive pronouns** include '**yours, your, my, mine, our, ours, its, his, her, hers, their, theirs '__**. These are all words that demonstrate **ownership.**
 
• **Theirs **is a possessive pronoun.
 
• So, the correct answer is **option 1.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__**

 
• ** **The idea that theirs needs an apostrophe comes out of the fact that every other word with, ‘s indicates possession, so English speakers sometimes think theirs should be spelled their’s. However, this is always incorrect – theirs is the only correct spelling.
